note: Accepted party_buff parameters of the party spells (owner S27; OTERYN_SPELL_NATIVE_BEHAVIOURS_CANDIDATE_V1.md C.3). The area is the radius-3 circle of 37 tiles on the caster's floor (C.3 step 2); at least one other member must be affected (min_affected 2 counts the caster); the mana is ceil(base x 0.9^(X-1) x X) rounded up (C.3 step 4); each member gets one condition for 120 s. A spell with a 'blocked' entry stays blocked for that reason.
